reason: The primitive monoclinic cell (about 7.3335 x 5.1246 x 5.3974 A, beta 94.221 degrees) and Z=1 are strongly supported by peak positions, and the submitted model has a plausible octahedral average framework. Exact recovery is not sufficiently established, however. No comparable whole-pattern Rwp was supplied; the reported 0.00437 is a custom residual on 118 extracted/clustered intensities after refining roughly 45 independent P1 coordinate variables, not a whole-profile/Rietveld validation. The trajectory's own profile optimization remains near 0.120 (and moves the coordinates away from the integrated-intensity optimum), while a direct profile consistency check of the submitted CIF leaves about 0.103 relative L2 mismatch and conspicuous intensity residuals. P1 was adopted as a convenient fully ordered realization after higher-symmetry searches failed, without a decisive symmetry test, and the O/F ordering is unresolved: multiple inequivalent O placements score within roughly 1-2% of the chosen custom objective, unsurprising given the weak O-versus-F X-ray contrast. Cr/Mo ordering and the detailed coordinates were also not exhaustively compared as distinct composition-correct periodic candidates. Another attempt is therefore warranted to refine and compare scientifically motivated symmetry/order variants against the full pattern and retain unresolved discrete alternatives.
